structured_output.world_model: W2 (empirical) after E017. Tip is E017: 6.548 s at 0.7537. That is 0.04 pp above the 0.753 bar, so the margin is effectively gone. E017's accuracy fell 0.7 pp from E016's 0.7607 while the math was supposedly unchanged, which makes reshuffle noise about ±0.3 pp. Measured rates: -0.5 epoch costs about 0.18 pp and saves about 4.8% of time. Time tracks pixel count (E007, E011). Width 576 to 512 cost 0.25 pp and saved 4.8%. CUDA graphs and graph-break removal saved under 1%, so the run is compute-bound. Weight decay /2 may have given +0.3 pp, but E017 suggests that was partly noise. Any idea that cuts time will probably push the 3-seed mean below 0.753 unless it is nearly free. Cutting 28 px steps to 24 px saves roughly 5-6% of time. I expect that to cost 0.2-0.4 pp, which likely fails the bar.

forecasts.reason: 28 px steps become 24 px, which is about 30% of steps at about 0.73x pixels, so about 5% faster. The accuracy cost is probably 0.1-0.4 pp, which lands near the bar.
Diagnostic with no recipe change. I expect the 10-seed mean to sit 0.2-0.4 pp below 0.7607 given the winner's curse, and E017's drop points the same way.
Cutting 1 epoch costs about 0.36 pp and saves about 9% of time. The starting margin is thin, so it probably falls just below 0.753.
Group 2 is about half of the MACs, so narrowing it saves about 5-6% of time. I expect a 0.2-0.4 pp cost, similar to the group 3 narrowing.
Time is unchanged. Weight-decay effects are small and noisy, and E017 suggests the earlier gain was partly reshuffle.
Dropping a conv in group 1 saves about 7% of time, but it loses depth at the highest resolution. I expect a loss of more than 0.4 pp.
15% of steps at 20 px instead of 24 px saves about 3-4% of time. The accuracy cost is mild, since E011's cliff came mostly from its 20 px share and the shortened later phases.

cruxes: What is the true 10-seed mean accuracy of the tip? E017's accuracy was 0.7537 against E016's 0.7607 for the same math, so the real margin over 0.753 is unclear.
Does the 28 px phase carry accuracy that the 24 and 32 px phases cannot replace?
Is the time per pp lost from cutting epochs lower than the time per pp lost from narrowing group 2 or dropping a conv?
